scope: Original M3 A/B shared-account daily strategy, birth window all 2022, observe through 2022-12-30 or first unsupported responsibility.
user_choice_verbatim: 同意以最高20%票面作为明确披露的研究保守代理并记录其影响，不宣称实税；完成后账期及统计明确标注，与未调整旧结果不可无条件混比。继续。

stock_research_haircut.new_quantity_basis: Actual own registered old quantity times official transfer ratio, exact per active layer integer.
stock_research_haircut.cash_posting: Debit owner round cash exactly once. Global cash is seed plus archive cash and must not be separately debited.
stock_research_haircut.cost_posting: Separate research_stock_tax_total and per-layer expense. Do not mutate historical buy_cash, spent, buy quantity, Layer.cost or actual trading fees.
stock_research_haircut.profit_and_risk: Actual cash debit is included by unchanged source mark, round/layer net PnL and wallet snapshot. Both prior-CLOSE and current-OPEN profitable-CP gates retain original clocks.
stock_research_haircut.negative_account_cash: Fail closed before mutation if this explicit debit would make global available cash negative. Do not borrow or silently defer.
stock_research_haircut.settlement: Nonrefundable research expense is complete on ex OPEN, not an open actual-tax claim that prevents round closure.
stock_research_haircut.no_later_refund: Do not infer a later zero rate or release/rebate from holding duration.

cash_dividend.basis: Actual registered OLD shares * official gross d_cash * 0.8
cash_dividend.pay_clock: Original pay CLOSE transfer, spendable no earlier than following common OPEN when intraday proof absent.
cash_dividend.no_double_count: Do not apply another 20% to cash dividend. Stock haircut is only on newly issued shares times evidenced par.

source_coordinate.600050_SH: d_source=0.0663, d_cash=0.0663, d_ref=0.0652; future factor audit is separate QA, not an announcement input.

supported_compound: Only explicit same-ex-day unlimited share listing/credit and exact integer per active CORE/ADD layer. Original dated full/partial odd-lot rules mandatory.
unsupported: Later listing, fractional allocation, bonus-share tax, source/clock gaps and other unadmitted actions remain responsibility UNKNOWN. No exclusion or tuning of stock selection.

reporting.canonical_NAV: Actual available cash after once-posted research stock haircut + confirmed receivable + raw CLOSE inventory market value, with original proven-halt stale-mark rules.
reporting.inventory_gross: Raw inventory market value before hypothetical sell slippage/fees, reported separately.
reporting.same_path_addback: If shown, canonical NAV plus cumulative stock haircut is same-path bookkeeping addback only, not an unadjusted strategy counterfactual.
reporting.hypothetical_liquidation: Keep separate from wallet marked NAV; actual trading fees allocated once.
reporting.open_rounds: No forced year-end sale. Open/settlement-open rounds excluded from closed win denominators; observation stop/phase always shown.
reporting.comparison: Do not unconditionally combine or compare with old no-stock-haircut result; research expense can change cash, profitability and later path.

prefix_test.compare: All action fields and all original phase/reconciliation economic fields; only elapsed time and peak RSS are nondeterministic and excluded. Separate new evidence/registration ledgers do not overwrite old economic fields.
prefix_test.old_full_stop: 2022-06-23 OPEN has 222 phases/254 actions and is not claimed equivalent after new compound treatment.

release: Fact-layer release and exact new pre-run stage independent release both required; synthetic-stage PASS is not permission. New directory and new O_EXCL once lock. Never resume old locks.
